caption: Figure 10.4: Two workflows for multi-port S-parameter extraction. Left: ModeMonitor projects transverse DFT fields (E_t, H_t) onto unit-power discrete waveguide eigenmodes (e_m, h_m) from solve_modes to separate forward (a_m⁺) and backward (a_m⁻) wave amplitudes in a single run. Right: wakis.sparameters.s_matrix drives N LumpedPort feeds one port at a time with matched Z₀ terminations on the other N−1 ports, computes Kurokawa power waves (a_j, b_i), checks passivity, and writes Touchstone .sNp files.
visual_intent:
Textbook-quality scientific schematic for a computational electromagnetics user manual. Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G, total-field or forward-wave quantities in blue; dual grid G-tilde, scattered-field, backward-wave, or equivalent-current quantities in orange; exact/topological/reference items in dark grey; matched monitor surfaces and conserved-power items in green; truncation limits or unresolved features in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Two equal panels side by side. LEFT PANEL headed '1. Waveguide Mode Orthogonality (ModeMonitor)': draw a 3D waveguide section with two green cross-sectional port planes: left plane 'mon1 (port 1, normal â)' and right plane 'mon2 (port 2, normal â)'. At port 1 show a forward blue arrow 'a₁⁺(f)' and reflected orange arrow 'a₁⁻(f)'; at port 2 show transmitted blue arrow 'a₂⁺(f)'. Below the waveguide display the exact overlap equations from the manual: 'a_m⁺(f) = ¼ ∬_port (E_t × h_m* + e_m* × H_t) · â dA', 'a_m⁻(f) = ¼ ∬_port (E_t × h_m* − e_m* × H_t) · â dA', and 'S₁₁(f) = a₁⁻(f) / a₁⁺(f),   S₂₁(f) = a₂⁺(f) / a₁⁺(f)'. RIGHT PANEL headed '2. Multi-Port Lumped S-Matrix (wakis.sparameters.s_matrix)': show a 2-port microwave filter block with 'port1' and 'port2' (LumpedPort, Z₀ = 50 Ω). Show Run 1 ('port1 driven, port2 terminated in Z₀') and Run N ('one port driven per run, N−1 ports terminated in matched Z₀'). Below, show the Kurokawa power-wave definitions: 'a_j = (V_j + Z₀ I_j) / (2√Z₀)', 'b_i = (V_i − Z₀ I_i) / (2√Z₀)', followed by an arrow to a green output box 'S(f) shape (n_freq, N, N) → write_touchstone("filter.s2p")' and passivity badge 'passivity check: σ_max(S(f)) ≤ 1'.
